messages:
olga-support: FYI invoice INV-98123 is on hold — customer uploaded a resale cert but our validator flagged a country mismatch. PO 7890 is required and billing portal set status to HOLD. Their uploaded VAT ID uses a BE number with a branch suffix '-B01' but the document header is NL. VIES returns country_mismatch. Attaching file: https://files.redwood.local/resale/INV-98123_resale_cert.pdf

sam-accounts: on it. is this from Acme Europe (acme-eu)? do we already have the PO scanned?

olga-support: yes acme-eu. customer pasted PO 7890 into the portal but the invoice engine still blocked it because VIES lookup failed. They say they operate multiple entities under same VAT with branch suffix. Uploaded PDF header says Netherlands but VAT ID starts with BE. Ticket: INC-8342.

nate-billing: looping in legal for manual override. if VIES rejects we can accept with secondary evidence (official registration + PO). @maria-legal can you confirm required docs for reverse-charge manual acceptance?

maria-legal: need both: (1) govt business registry page showing legal entity + country, (2) VAT registration certificate or equivalent showing the VAT number and branch mapping, and (3) PO showing buyer VAT if available. redacted copies ok. Also we need a short approval note saved to audit logs.

olga-support: repro steps for engineering/billing logs:
1) customer uploads resale_cert.pdf via billing portal
2) portal webhook -> POST /billing/vat/validate with payload {"vat_id":"BE123456789-B01","country":"NL"}
3) our validator returns 422 {"error":"country_mismatch"}
4) we call VIES service -> response: {"status":"INVALID","detail":"Country code does not match VAT number"}
5) invoice set to HOLD and route to billing queue PO_REQUIRED

sam-accounts: log excerpt:```
[2026-01-24T08:12:07Z] POST /billing/vat/validate body={"vat_id":"BE123456789-B01","country":"NL"} status=422 err=country_mismatch
[2026-01-24T08:12:07Z] vies_lookup(vat=BE123456789) -> INVALID (country code mismatch)
```

sre-bot: FYI there was a VIES connector rate-limit incident earlier today between 08:12-08:28 UTC, retries 2x, but this thread's error is explicit country_mismatch (not a timeout). See INC-RATE-112 for upstream behaviour.

nate-billing: customer also reported a card decline last week when trying to pay the non-exempt invoice — different txn but flagged on the same account. We should avoid double-blocking them. If legal approves manual override I can mark INV-98123 RELEASED and add note "manual_vat_override:approved:maria-legal" and keep full evidence attached. Need audit trail.

maria-legal: I will review the registry link and the redacted cert. Share the registry URL. If registry shows NL entity with BE VAT we want additional proof of cross-border tax registration — exports/imports doc or tax authority letter.

olga-support: registry: https://company-registry.nl/companies/12345 — shows company name and NL address but VAT field lists 'BE123456789-B01' (screenshot in attachment). Customer insists branch is registered in BE but invoices from NL.

sam-accounts: proposed temporary process: billing ops can apply internal tag `manual_vat_override` with evidence bundle attached and outcome logged. I can implement a soft-flag in the billing console to require 2 approvers for release. Acceptable?

nate-billing: OK. implement 2-step approval (billing + legal). I'll create a workflow ticket and set SLA 24h.

maria-legal: I'll prioritise review within 12h. If everything checks out and the evidence proves reverse-charge eligibility, I will sign off. Otherwise we'll ask customer for the tax authority letter.

olga-support: thanks — I'll message the customer with checklist: 1) redacted VAT registration cert showing mapping of branch suffix 2) PO showing billing address + VAT id 3) screenshot of registry page. Will escalate if they push urgent.

sam-accounts: :thumbsup:

nate-billing: leaving note: will not change invoice state until legal OK. updating INC-8342.

olga-support: closing loop here for now — will post back when customer uploads the extra evidence.
